name: The Honor of the Kor'kron
summary: Commander Folkar’s Kor’kron were sent to Alcaz Prison to extract Varian Wrynn alive. With the commander injured and his elites dead, the search falls to you.

sections.title: A King in Alcaz
sections.body: The Kor’kron came to Alcaz Prison seeking Varian Wrynn, King of Stormwind. Their Warchief ordered them to bring him alive to Orgrimmar. Now their commander’s axe arm is broken and most of his elites are dead. You take up the search while he waits behind.

sections.title: The Search
sections.body: Black dragons complicate the Kor’kron’s effort to find Varian. After you slay a lesser dragon, the commander believes a greater force is pulling the strings. He sends you to tell Commander Folkar what you learned.

faq.q: Why are the Kor’kron at Alcaz Prison?
faq.answer: They were sent to extract Varian Wrynn and bring him alive to Orgrimmar on the Warchief’s orders.

faq.q: Who are the Kor’kron looking for?
faq.answer: They are searching Alcaz Prison for Varian Wrynn, King of Stormwind.

faq.q: Why does the search fall to me?
faq.answer: The commander’s axe arm is broken, and most of his elites are dead, so he asks you to continue the search.
The presence of black dragons complicates their effort to find Varian.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry out the Warchief’s order to bring Varian Wrynn alive to Orgrimmar.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Honor of the Kor'kron
